items: Launched on April 14, 2016, to create a unified electronic platform for agricultural trade across India.
The scheme aims to provide farmers with better access to markets, fair prices, and reduce reliance on
 One Nation, One Market: Facilitates interstate agricultural marketing with a single license.
 Direct Payments: Payments are made directly to farmers’ bank accounts.
 Real-Time Price Discovery: Transparent pricing and quality assurance for agricultural products.
 Removal of Intermediaries: Reduces the role of middlemen in agricultural transactions.
 Over 1.77 crore farmers and 1389 markets registered.
 Facilitates online trading, ensuring wider market reach for farmers.
 Implemented by SFAC (Small Farmers Agribusiness Consortium).
 Enhances farmer income by providing better market access.
 Supports agriculture exports and value-added agribusiness.
 Expands market reach, connecting farmers with national and international buyers.
The initiative aims to revolutionize India's agricultural market by enhancing transparency, improving
farmers' income, and creating a more competitive trading environment.
